snippets.en: And they who are not sanctified through the law which I have given unto you, even the law of Christ, must inherit another kingdom, even that of a terrestrial kingdom, or that of a telestial kingdom.
snippets.tr: Y aquellos que no son santificados por la ley que os he dado, a saber, la ley de Cristo, deberán heredar otro reino, ya sea un reino terrestre o un reino telestial.
